name: SimplePractice vs Sessions Health
title: SimplePractice vs Sessions Health: EHR Comparison for Therapists (2026)
description: Compare SimplePractice and Sessions Health for therapy practices. See differences in pricing, features, telehealth, billing, and which EHR offers better value.

summary.bottom_line: SimplePractice is the polished market leader with e-prescribing and broader features. Sessions Health offers significant cost savings (~$30/month cheaper) with solid core EHR features—ideal for cost-conscious practices. Choose SimplePractice for premium polish and e-prescribing; choose Sessions Health for value.

sections.heading: SimplePractice vs Sessions Health: Overview
sections.content: SimplePractice is the market leader in therapy EHRs with over 225,000 clinicians and a reputation for polish and client portal excellence. Sessions Health is a value-focused alternative that offers similar core features at significantly lower prices. Both handle scheduling, documentation, billing, and telehealth—the question is whether SimplePractice's premium polish justifies the price difference.

sections.heading: Pricing: The Key Difference
sections.content: Sessions Health saves approximately $30/month compared to SimplePractice for solo practitioners—roughly $360/year. For group practices, the savings multiply: a 3-clinician practice saves approximately $111/month (~$1,330/year) with Sessions Health. Sessions Health also offers a free tier for up to 3 active clients, letting new therapists start without any software cost. SimplePractice has no free tier (only a 30-day trial).

sections.heading: Feature Comparison
sections.content: SimplePractice has features Sessions Health lacks: e-prescribing ($49/mo add-on), group telehealth sessions with up to 15 participants, and a more polished client portal. Sessions Health's telehealth requires a $10/month add-on per practitioner. For prescribers who need e-prescribing, SimplePractice is the only choice. For non-prescribing therapists, Sessions Health's core features cover most needs at lower cost.

sections.heading: Interface & Client Experience
sections.content: SimplePractice's client portal is widely considered industry-leading—it sets a high bar for client-facing experience. The overall interface is more refined. Sessions Health is functional and clean but not as polished. For practices where client experience is a top priority (high-end private pay practices, for example), SimplePractice's polish may justify the premium.

sections.heading: Which Should You Choose?
sections.content: Match the platform to your priorities:

recommendations.when: You need e-prescribing capabilities, client portal excellence is important to your practice, you want group telehealth with multiple participants, you value premium polish and brand recognition, or you're willing to pay more for refinement

You're cost-conscious and want to save $360-1,330/year, you're a non-prescribing therapist (no e-prescribing needed), you're starting out and want the free tier, you have a group practice where savings multiply, or you need solid core EHR without premium pricing
You want 24/7 support—neither SimplePractice nor Sessions Health matches TherapyNotes' round-the-clock availability

faqs.q: How much cheaper is Sessions Health than SimplePractice?
faqs.a: Sessions Health saves approximately $30/month for solo practitioners (~$360/year). For a 3-clinician group practice, savings are approximately $111/month (~$1,330/year). Sessions Health also has a free tier for up to 3 active clients.

faqs.q: Does Sessions Health have e-prescribing like SimplePractice?
faqs.a: No. Sessions Health does not offer e-prescribing. SimplePractice offers e-prescribing as an add-on ($49/month plus $89 setup). If you're a prescriber, SimplePractice is the better choice.

faqs.q: Is Sessions Health's telehealth included or extra?
faqs.a: Sessions Health charges $10/month per practitioner for telehealth as an add-on. SimplePractice includes telehealth on Essential and Plus plans. Factor this into your cost comparison if telehealth is important.

faqs.q: Does Sessions Health have a free plan?
faqs.a: Yes. Sessions Health offers a free tier for up to 3 active clients, making it possible to start your practice with zero software costs. SimplePractice only offers a 30-day free trial with no ongoing free tier.
